notes: Stargate.sol:unstake/_delegate — when a delegator requested exit and the validator later exits, delegatorsEffectiveStake is decreased twice; the second subtraction underflows and unstake reverts permanently. Fixed in f7d2259b (guard + _hasRequestedExit helper + floor-at-zero — the floor is what kills the revert).

source: Immunefi Audit Comp | VeChain | Stargate Hayabusa (2025-11) — ~24 reports, e.g. #59316, #59358, #59361 (@humanitia et al.), #59563 — https://github.com/immunefi-team/Past-Audit-Competitions/tree/main/vechain-or-stargate-hayabusa
notes: Stargate.sol:_claimableDelegationPeriods — the endPeriod > nextClaimablePeriod boundary skips the ended-delegation branch when equal, so claims run up to the validator's completedPeriods and pay post-exit periods. Fixed in f7d2259b (endPeriod <= lastClaimedPeriod guard + >= boundary + cursor advance on zero-claims).
